title: 3DSkinLayers 1.7.10
body:
## About This Mod
This mod enables the use of 3D skins in MC 1.7.10.
Skinport, UniMixins, and GTNH Lib are required as dependencies.

## It does not work correctly with BSL-based shaders.
![Issue with BSL-style shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67465be77e22a8b86a8acf9c3c679386262293e1_0.webp)

## It works perfectly with SEUS-style shaders.
![Images showing performance with SEUS-style shaders.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e29602c27b8a0c6c56d6f936ac6941e728699fd_0.webp)

## Of course, it works if shaders are disabled.
![3D skin image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a071b418e3452be0dccd65f26e0f1e3b903c2999.png)

Operation with OptiFine has not been tested, and it is not recommended.
